purpose: Teach: 読み書き/本誌/常務/出回っ/既婚/上述/免責/全長

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新人の読み書きのレベルを確認しろ
lines.en: Check the new employees' reading and writing proficiency.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Delivery is matter-of-fact, no room for questions. Measured pace. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本誌のインタビューを準備しております
lines.en: Yes. We're preparing the interview for our magazine.
lines.style: Crisp acknowledgment with slight forward lean. Professional and attentive. Pitch lifts slightly on the task detail, showing readiness. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の常務を発表しろ
lines.en: Announce the appointment of the new managing director.
lines.style: Direct, economical with words. Steady eye contact implied. No inflection for emphasis—the instruction carries its own weight. Brief pause between clauses.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ネット上に偽情報が出回っている件、対応します
lines.en: Yes. We're handling the misinformation circulating online.
lines.style: Calm assurance with a hint of resolution underneath. Acknowledging the problem without alarm. Measured delivery. Slight emphasis on 'handling'—competence assumed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、既婚社員の福利厚生を見直せ
lines.en: Review the benefits package for married employees.
lines.style: Steady, businesslike. Slight downward inflection at the end—a directive, not a request. Brief and final. The tone of someone moving through a checklist of priorities.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。上述の方針通り進めます
lines.en: Yes. We'll proceed according to the policy we discussed.
lines.style: Efficient nod in the voice. Quick, professional tone. Implies understanding and compliance without over-explanation. Lean into the reassurance slightly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、免責事項を契約書に明記しろ
lines.en: Make the liability clause explicit in the contract.
lines.style: Firm and non-negotiable. Slow, deliberate pace. Weight on 'explicit.' The instruction of someone who has seen what happens when contracts are unclear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新型車の全長を発表しました
lines.en: Yes. We've released the specifications for the new vehicle model.
lines.style: Closing statement with quiet finality. Professional tone, slightly lower energy as the exchange winds down. Delivered as confirmation of completion, not anticipation of follow-up.
